## Change

Describe the problem and the implemented behavior.

## Risk

- [ ] No production or cloud configuration impact
- [ ] Security, data, and permission boundaries reviewed
- [ ] CodeQL and secret-scanning results reviewed
- [ ] Versioned engineering-contract impact reviewed
- [ ] Any CI recovery rerun is linked and its original failure is explained
- [ ] Rollback or recovery path documented when needed

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Include links to relevant CI or runtime evidence.

- [ ] `npm run data:check`
- [ ] `npm run docs:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`

## Agent Contribution

- [ ] No AI agent contributed to this change
- [ ] AI agent contributed; its changes and evidence received human review

## Reviewer Notes

Call out unresolved risks, skipped checks, and follow-up work.
